'''Caleb Jones Caleb's EBO''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Caleb's EBO'''. [[Caleb Jones]] posted it on 7 September 2000.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Caleb Jones]]
* '''Published:''' 7 September 2000 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Caleb's EBO
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 MPG Jones LS 2000 Red32.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Simple and easy to play, get EBO goin' and then use Incom Corporation to boost up the T-47's and the X-wings for battling. With EBO X-wings are real cheap. Beatdown with speeders and X-wings. Only problem I see is maybe a manipulation deck.
